summary: Prepare the RHEL host as the non-root user: set an FQDN hostname with hostnamectl, register with subscription-manager, and make sure only BaseOS and AppStream repos are enabled (dnf repolist).
questions: How do I prepare RHEL for containerized AAP?
Does the AAP host need an FQDN?
Which repositories should be enabled for containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Prepare the RHEL host
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
hostname -f                                   # must be an FQDN
sudo hostnamectl set-hostname <fqdn>          # if not
sudo subscription-manager register
sudo dnf repolist                             # only BaseOS and AppStream
```
